title: Delete record
description: One line of deleted.json, which delete writes and the digest lists (DESIGN.md §2.6, §2.8): the ID, title, state, time and whether it came from an interactive terminal, and nothing else of the item. Each line is one JSON object, oldest first.

id.description: The deleted item's ID. It's never handed out again.

title.description: The item's title when it was deleted.

status.description: The state the item was in when it was deleted.

interactive.description: Whether stdin was a terminal. delete refuses otherwise, so false means the file was written some other way (DESIGN.md §2.6).
